basics.name: Jack Stehn
basics.label: Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineer | Data Scientist
basics.summary: High-agency Data Professional specializing in bridging the gap between 'notebook data science' and production-grade scalable infrastructure. I architect end-to-end systems—from raw ingestion to deploying predictive models that drive revenue. I bring a software engineering mindset to data teams, championing CI/CD, unit testing, and modular design to untangle complexity and build maintainable tools.

work.name: Innovare
highlights: **K-12 Student Data Quality:** Worked across school partners' student data, including assessment scores, grades, and attendance. Validated it end to end, from source systems to final reports, and wrote automated data tests to catch errors before they reached educators.

**EdTech Analytics Reliability:** Specialized in the stability and scalability of the EdTech analytics layer, ensuring high-stakes dashboards and datasets are accurate, reliable, and actionable for school leadership teams.

**Enterprise Customer Delivery:** Managed complex data pipelines, automated manual workflows, and delivered presentation-ready insights for enterprise accounts — translating raw data into decision-ready artifacts for non-technical stakeholders.

**Data Architecture Consulting:** Helped design the next-generation data architecture, proposing a transition plan to a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) infrastructure on BigQuery to improve traceability, testability, costs, and downstream analytics velocity.

**Modern Stack Proposal:** Proposed adopting a modern open-source stack — Terraform for IaC, dlt for ingestion, dbt for transformation, Dagster for orchestration, Cube.js for semantic layer — to replace ad-hoc workflows with a maintainable, version-controlled, observable platform.
**Technical Guidance:** Guided the team's use of dbt and Dagster to build extensible analytical assets, speeding up custom solution deployment across multi-tenant clients.
**Workflow Automation:** Automated previously manual customer delivery workflows to reduce turnaround time and free engineering capacity for higher-leverage analytics work.
**Customer Data Verification Tool:** Built a tool for the Customer Success team to verify that incoming customer data loaded correctly, and wrote a guide so they could run it on their own.

work.name: Caliber Public Schools
work.position: Data Scientist (Lead: ML, Data Engineering, MLOps) - Ed Pioneers Fellow
highlights: **Strategic Leadership (Solo Data Lead):** Owned the full data lifecycle (DS, DE, ML) as the sole data scientist. Partnered directly with C-suite and department heads to navigate a 'zero-to-one' environment, moving the org from manual spreadsheets to automated warehousing.

**Predictive ML & Risk Modeling:** Developed and deployed explainable ML models (Logistic Regression, Deep Learning) to predict staff turnover. Engineered a 'Risk Tolerance' configuration allowing non-technical leadership to adjust precision/recall thresholds based on quarterly hiring capacity.

**Modern Data Stack Architecture:** Architected and built a scalable platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Orchestrated ELT pipelines using Dagster, dbt, and dlt to ingest data from disparate SIS (School Information Systems) and HR platforms.

**Engineering Maturity (ROI):** Engineered a comprehensive People Team data pipeline, reducing manual consistency checks from months of collective annual work to seconds. Built a custom automated data quality framework to catch inconsistencies between systems.

**API Integration & Interoperability:** Solved complex data interoperability challenges by designing integrations between Schoolmint and PowerSchool. Reverse-engineered undocumented APIs to create a unified data model for cross-functional analysis.

**Cross-Department Data Partner:** Served as the go-to data partner for the Enrollment, HR, and Special Education teams, learning each team's workflows and data needs; built tools the Special Education department uses to work with its own data.

**Data Democratization:** Updated the organization's data security policy and designed data literacy training modules, empowering school leaders to access real-time attendance and academic metrics without technical bottlenecks.

**Survey Design & Enrichment:** Leveraged data to enrich staff satisfaction surveys with demographic, work location, role, grade level, and tenure data, enabling highly segmented and actionable insights.
**Stakeholder Management:** Partnered with leadership on high-impact, data-driven solutions; presented findings to stakeholders including the Board of Directors.

work.name: SetSail
highlights: **Business Impact:** Contributed to product enhancements that achieved 33% faster ramp times, 16% higher revenue, and 15x ROI for customers.

**Production ML (Revenue):** Developed and deployed production ML models for Propensity Scoring (deal closure probability) and Churn Modeling. Leveraged NLP on unstructured email metadata to identify sales signals.

**Pipeline Architecture (AWS):** Led a critical overhaul of the AWS data infrastructure (S3, Athena, EMR). Implemented 'SQL Push-down' strategies and asynchronous DAGs, reducing data processing latency by 75% and scaling to multi-terabyte datasets.
**Scalable Data Modeling:** Architected scalable Star Schema data models and optimized ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data readiness for LLM integration.
**Engineering Best Practices:** Championed the adoption of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), unit testing (pytest), and Agile methodologies within the data science team.
**Causal Analysis:** Performed deep causal inference studies to isolate specific sales behaviors that drive outcomes, influencing the product roadmap to focus on 'high-leverage' user actions.
**Technical Consulting:** Acted as a technical consultant for enterprise customers, diagnosing complex data discrepancies and proposing architectural solutions for data integration.
**Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborated seamlessly with Engineering, Product, and Support teams to spec out large-scale infrastructure restructuring.

work.name: UC Berkeley School of Public Health
highlights: **Leadership:** Led data science components for mixed-methods studies on equity and public health (specifically violence against homeless youth). Managed a team of undergraduates.

**Unstructured Data:** Analyzed diverse unstructured and non-traditional datasets (qualitative interviews, geospatial data, text corpora, hand-drawn maps) requiring the development of novel data processing approaches.

**Geospatial Analysis:** Led geospatial analysis of violence against homeless youth in San Francisco, combining location data with Census geography (ArcGIS, GeoPandas, GeoJSON) to identify and visualize spatial patterns for non-technical stakeholders.
**Visualization:** Created interactive dashboards (Tableau, Plotly) to communicate findings to stakeholders.
**Interdisciplinary Collaboration:** Collaborated across disciplines (public health, psychology, sociology) ensuring ethical, robust research.

work.name: Los Medanos College

**Data Acquisition:** Built a database of 500+ university programs via web scraping (Beautiful Soup) and rigorous data cleaning.
**Stakeholder Consulting:** Consulted with college stakeholders (district, counselors) to define user needs.
**UX/UI:** Created an intuitive management dashboard for non-technical staff.

projects.name: Dagster People Team Pipeline
projects.summary: Developed a data pipeline using Dagster to ingest People Team data from various sources into Google BigQuery. Designed, built, and deployed an automated Dagster pipeline on GCP to ingest, transform, and load diverse HR data for comprehensive People analytics.
highlights: **Automated ETL:** Architected and implemented a scalable ETL pipeline using Dagster for orchestrating data workflows from various HR sources (BambooHR, Paycom, internal docs) into Google BigQuery.

**Automated QA:** Automated data consistency checks, reducing manual validation efforts from months annually to seconds, significantly improving data accuracy and reducing human error across HR systems.
**Predictive Analytics:** Enabled rich longitudinal and cross-referential data analysis, enriching staff satisfaction surveys with detailed segmentation (location, role, demographics, tenure).
**Data Interoperability:** Designed the pipeline with explicit consideration for integration with diverse data systems and platforms, ensuring broad interoperability.

projects.name: Self-Hosted LLM Agent Tooling
projects.summary: Self-hosted LLM agents that act on my own email, tasks, documents, and home through tools I designed and secured.
highlights: **Self-Hosted Agent (Hermes):** Deployed Nous Research's Hermes agent as a sandboxed NixOS service on a local Ollama model, used over Telegram, with custom skills for email triage, task and habit tracking, document search, and smart-home control, plus a scheduled 7:00 daily digest.

**Least-Privilege Tool Design:** Wrote a credential broker that is the only holder of service tokens and exposes narrow commands to the agent (read-only email apart from labels, read-only documents and calendar), a hook that blocks unsafe tool calls, and Telegram approve/deny for risky shell commands.
**MCP Tool Integration:** Connect Claude Code and Hermes to self-hosted services over MCP, giving agents typed tools that act on real data instead of guessing.
**Model Evaluation:** Built a script that compares local models on real agent tasks to choose which one to run.
**Reproducible Infrastructure:** Declare the whole stack as code on a Proxmox / NixOS home lab (Nix modules, Docker Compose, agenix-managed secrets).

projects.name: Semantic Search & Recommendation Engine
projects.summary: Personal project: a crawler, archive, and recommendation web app for an online fiction community, built to search and discover stories by meaning rather than keywords.
highlights: **Polite Crawler:** Built an authenticated crawler with request delays, page limits, and incremental update checks that fetch only new content, parsing pages into structured story, series, and author records.

**Vector Search:** Stored the archive in PostgreSQL with pgvector and an HNSW index; encoded each document with a sentence-transformers model (BGE-large) and ranked by cosine similarity, with a TF-IDF tag-overlap fallback.
**Ranking Logic:** Boosted same-author results, excluded trivial matches, weighted likes above reads, diversified results per author, and topped up short lists with top-rated content.
**Engineering:** FastAPI web app with full-text search, a hand-written SQL migration runner, a SQLite-to-PostgreSQL migration, and a pytest suite run against real Postgres (testcontainers).

projects.name: DataSF Employee Compensation Pipeline
projects.summary: End-to-end pipeline for San Francisco's public Employee Compensation dataset, built on PostgreSQL with each design choice mapped to its Snowflake equivalent.
highlights: **Analytics Engineering:** pandas ingestion into a raw landing schema, then dbt staging (type casting, deduplication) and marts (total compensation, tenure brackets).
**Access Control:** Row-level security policies, a security-definer masking view, and a public-safe aggregate view, with pytest tests verifying what each role can and can't see.
**Infrastructure as Code & CI:** Terraform manages roles, grants, default privileges, and per-role resource limits; CI runs terraform plan plus dbt compile and test on every pull request.

projects.name: Proxy Library (TypeScript Learning Project)
projects.summary: Self-hosted web app for a Magic: The Gathering playgroup, built to learn TypeScript and practice team-style engineering. Most code was written by an AI coding assistant (Claude Code) against design documents I set and reviewed.
highlights: **Full-Stack TypeScript:** Next.js, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth, covering collections, trading, an append-only money ledger, live drafts, a searchable deck builder, and PDF export.
**Data Sync:** Nightly sync and caching of card data from the MTGJSON and Scryfall APIs.

**Engineering Process:** A design document approved before each phase, architecture decision records, unit and integration tests (Vitest), end-to-end browser tests (Playwright), and Docker deployment on my home server.

projects.name: Chorus Memo (Choral Music Practice App)
projects.summary: Private web app for memorizing choral music, running entirely on local hardware with no paid or online services.
highlights: **Speech & Audio ML:** Times lyrics to practice tracks with local Whisper transcription (faster-whisper) and analyzes audio with librosa for a waveform practice player with A/B looping and slowdown.
**Document Extraction:** Pulls lyrics by voice part from score PDFs (PyMuPDF, OCR for scans) and reads a part's notes with optical music recognition (Audiveris) to build a singer line and MIDI.
**Incremental Import:** Imports MobileSheets set-list exports, adding only what's new and detecting voice parts from file names.

projects.name: San Francisco Public Transit Datathon (Jan 2021)
projects.summary: Analyzed public transportation availability in San Francisco and proposed an on-demand shuttle service, mainly for riders with disabilities, with shuttles stationed around the city to pick people up on request.
highlights: **Transit Access Analysis:** Joined transit data with Census GeoJSON boundaries and demographics (GeoPandas, Shapely) to map where public transportation availability was weakest.
**Shuttle Placement:** Used that analysis to choose where to station shuttles so they could reach the most riders who needed them.

projects.name: ResumeLLM (AI Agent for Resume Tailoring)
projects.summary: Engineered a sophisticated AI agent using LangChain and LangGraph to automate and enhance resume tailoring, showcasing advanced capabilities in generative AI, natural language processing, and complex system orchestration.
highlights: **Agentic AI System:** Developed a robust, agent-based system for precise and context-aware resume customization based on specific job descriptions and user preferences.
**Complex Orchestration:** Leveraged LangChain and LangGraph to design and implement sophisticated AI agent orchestration, enabling complex multi-step reasoning and dynamic workflow management.
**NLP & Parsing:** Applied advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) techniques to parse job requirements, extract key skills, and generate tailored resume content.
**Iterative Optimization:** Designed the system to iteratively refine resume drafts, demonstrating capabilities in iterative AI feedback loops and intelligent document optimization.

projects.name: Firewatch Chatbot (CalSAFE DataGood)
projects.summary: Developed a Facebook chatbot for CalSAFE providing California wildfire information by classifying user question intent using NLP.
highlights: **Intent Classification:** Built NLP intent classification model using spaCy (vectorization) & scikit-learn (Logistic Regression).
**Dataset Creation:** Manually collected & classified ~450 question dataset with team.
**Bot Logic:** Designed bot logic providing responses based on classified intent.
**Deployment:** Integrated with Facebook API & planned deployment via Flask/Heroku.

highlights: **Language Modeling:** Applied language modeling to analyze patterns in historical legal text.
**NLP Exploration:** Focused on personal learning and exploration of NLP techniques.

references.name: Amanda Szramiak (Worked with Jack on the same team at Innovare) - Customer Success Manager
references.reference:
I'm glad to recommend Jack Stehn. Jack and I worked together at an ed-tech company, where I was a Customer Success Manager and Jack was Data Analytics & Customer Delivery Engineer. Jack was the person the team relied on for anything involving data. In the time we worked together, Jack was one of the most dependable colleagues I've had: when they committed to something, I knew it would get done.

Jack has a real talent for spotting problems early. They regularly caught and fixed issues before anyone else realized something was wrong, and when they found a bug they didn't stop at flagging it. They often shipped the fix themselves. That instinct reached beyond their own work, too. When Jack saw potential problems in a data pipeline and infrastructure plan from another team, they took the initiative to review it and proposed concrete changes based on their own experience.

Much of what Jack did had no playbook. When they joined, many of their responsibilities were things they had to figure out for themselves, and they did: learning new systems quickly, building dashboards, and getting up to speed on education data. They learned all about assessments, attendance, behavior data, and the other pieces that make K-12 data complicated, and that knowledge made them a resource for the rest of the team.

Jack also made the people around them more effective. They documented processes carefully and kept looking for ways to make our work more efficient. When my team needed a way to verify that customer data was coming in correctly, Jack built a tool for it and wrote a guide so the rest of us could use it on our own.

Just as important, Jack is a genuinely kind colleague. They listened to people's challenges and helped whenever they could.

I would gladly work with Jack again, and I'm confident they'll be a strong addition to any team.
